title: ABC World News Tonight with David Muir Full Broadcast - Aug. 12, 2026 - Main Stream Videos
text:
Martha Raddatz has the latest on the U.S. Army Apache attack helicopter crash in a field near Fort Hood, Texas, that killed both the pilot and co-pilot on board and sparking a raging fire; with ICE tactics already facing fierce scrutiny, Jay O’Brien has details on DHS’ plans to spend up to $20 million on specialized gloves agents can use to incapacitate someone with an electric shock – describing them as “deescalation devices;” Maggie Rulli reports from Reykjavik, Iceland, where a solar eclipse hasn’t been seen in nearly 600 years, as millions from around the world came together to watch the celestial event; and more on tonight’s broadcast of World News Tonight with David Muir.
